title: Lake Powell Boat Rental
specs: Launch and retrieval handled by staff via Antelope Point Marina valet service
Lake Powell offers access to Antelope Canyon, Horseshoe Bend, Rainbow Bridge National Monument
Minimum age 25 to rent a surf boat
No boating certification required, prior boating experience preferred
Valid ID matching credit card required
Liability waiver must be signed before departure
Boats seat from 7 to 10 people depending on model
blurb: Guests rent boats such as wakeboard, ski, and recreational boats to explore Lake Powell. Rentals include safety gear and a map, with valet launch and retrieval service. Operators must be at least 25 years old for surf boats and sign a liability waiver.
extraNote: Damage deposit $1000 for all boat rentals · Fuel charge based on usage: $42.50 for 1/4 tank or less, $85 for 1/4 to 1/2 tank, $170 for more than 1/2 tank · Rentals must be returned by 5:30 PM Arizona Time · Cancellation due to weather: rebook or full refund before check-in; no refund if already on water · Valet launch and retrieval fee $60 not included in booking · Antelope Point Marina for boat launch and retrieval via valet service
